name: NavSafe
subtitle: Early-access iPhone builds of NavSafe.
description: The SideStore source for NavSafe: turn-by-turn navigation that shows the drivers behind you your next move on a rear-window sign. Builds here arrive before the App Store release.

apps.name: NavSafe
apps.subtitle: Show drivers behind you your next turn.
apps.localizedDescription:
NavSafe is turn-by-turn navigation built on Google Maps that can also drive a rear-window LED sign, showing the drivers behind you your next turn and how far away it is.

• Explore the map, search for places and browse nearby petrol, parking, food and more
• Place cards with photos, ratings, opening hours, phone and website
• Driving directions with live traffic, alternative routes, up to three stops, and options to avoid tolls, motorways and ferries
• Turn-by-turn voice guidance with speed limits, a route overview and search along your route
• Saved lists, Home and Work, recent destinations and saved routes
• A live on-screen mirror of the sign on every drive, so you can try NavSafe without any hardware
• Light and dark themes that follow your iPhone

About this build: this is an early-access build shared through SideStore while the App Store version is in review. CarPlay and Sign in with Apple aren't available here, so sign in with your email address instead. NavSafe needs your location to navigate; choose "Always" if you want the sign to keep working with the screen off.

versions.localizedDescription:
The biggest update yet: NavSafe now works much more like Google Maps, with more than 140 improvements across search, places, directions, driving and your saved places.

• Search: type or say "petrol" and you get the Petrol results. Petrol, charging, parking, cash machines, pharmacies and groceries now show as compact rows with Call and Directions, and filters fit each one (your fuel grade, cheapest, available now, rapid, free parking, price, rating, accessible). Pins that would overlap shrink to dots, and Back takes you to the same spot in the list
• Places: a place that has closed down or hasn't opened yet now says so. Your fuel grade's price leads the card, with how old it is. A new ••• menu lets you set Home or Work, park here, or open the place in Google Maps. There's an About tab of Google's facts, holiday and drive-through hours, plus codes, review details from Google, and photos you can pinch to zoom and swipe away
• Directions: tap the from or to field to change it, and tap any step to walk through the route on the map. Trips can have up to 8 stops, with an arrival time for each and an editor to reorder them. Add-stop suggests Home, Work, recent places and stops along your route. Plan a drive up to a week ahead with the new time wheel, and routes to big venues end at the entrance
• Driving: roundabouts show which exit to take, just like your rear sign, and the time to arrive turns amber or red in heavy traffic. The first instruction says which way to head, lanes are easier to read, and along-route results are numbered on the map. NavSafe now remembers where you parked when you arrive, and you can turn the voice up or down (Settings > Sound & voice)
• Your places: your lists show on the Explore map (hide any list from its ••• menu), and each list gets its own page with a small map. Signed in, you can give places your own private labels like "Mum's" or "Gym". Home and Work now keep the full address and show your drive time, and you can set them without signing in: they stay on this phone until you do
• Explore names the area you're in. Settings is split into clear sections and adds an Auto map that turns dark from sunset to sunrise. Help has search, and Trips has a day-by-day view
• Smoother everywhere: sheets drag down to close, toasts have a Try again button, and the app follows Bold Text and Increase Contrast

Fixes the rear sign going dark after the last update, plus a big round of fixes from testing the whole app end to end.

• The rear sign shows its arrows again. Since the last build the sign could stay dark or keep reconnecting: NavSafe misread the sign's "already showing this" reply. It now reconnects one attempt at a time, and a blank always reaches the sign first
• Search finds places near you: typing "coffee" or "petrol" lists nearby places with distances, and offers "Coffee near you" / "Petrol near you". Recent places open with their full details
• Category results now fit on the map, and "within" distances match the cards
• If the map stayed light in dark mode after an earlier update, it follows the app again (Settings > Appearance > Map). Pick Light there if you prefer it
• Driving: the last stretch shows the distance and your destination's name, the larger on-screen sign no longer hides your car near turns, route overview keeps the destination in view, and the drive menu shows every option
• Route preview: no more endless "Waiting for your location" when location was never allowed, stops can be reordered, and the time bubbles no longer overlap
• Fixes for large text sizes and landscape: sheets no longer go blank when you change text size, nothing hides behind the Dynamic Island, and You and Sign stay upright
• Sign tab: choosing the on-screen preview turns it on, a sign test stops when you leave the tab, and the brightness slider follows your finger
• Many smaller fixes: Google's navigation terms are readable in dark mode, clearer messages when you're signed out, tidier trips and diagnostic reports, and NavSafe uses less battery after a drive

A redrawn rear sign, widgets and a Live Activity, arrival-time sharing and a new You tab.

• Every picture on the rear sign is redrawn for its 64×16 panel. Roundabouts use the full height with the exit number inside the ring, left and right arrows are symmetric, and the distance countdown only ever counts down
• Save several signs and choose the one in use. Setup's arrow check can be watched from behind the car, and the Sign tab shows one status that matches what the sign is really showing
• Near a turn, a larger copy of your sign appears on screen above the drive card
• Share your arrival time from the drive menu. The link opens a plain web page with your destination, your arrival time and the miles left in whole miles (none in the last mile). It never shows where you are, and it expires soon after the drive ends
• Your drive shows on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. New Home and Lock Screen widgets drive you home or to work, show where you parked or open your sign. The widgets and the Live Activity are one app extension, so NavSafe now uses 2 of the 10 App IDs a free Apple ID can register each week. If AltStore offers to remove app extensions, removing them also removes the widgets and the Live Activity
• The You tab is now your own page: this week's drives, distance and time at the wheel, your lists as tiles and your latest trips
• Trips show each drive's route as a thumbnail, this week's and this month's totals, and a trip page with a map. The route line stays on this phone
• Explore leads with petrol nearby (cheapest first for your fuel), chargers free now and parking. NavSafe remembers where you parked, with walking directions back to your car
• Search by voice, and find places from your contacts and calendar. Recent searches now work without an account too
• Plan a drive to leave at, or arrive by, a set time
• Share a list or a route as Google Maps links that open back in NavSafe
• Place cards show Google reviews
• Spoken directions use the distance units you chose in Settings, and the step list, stops and road names follow the live drive more closely
• Trip backup now belongs to one account. If you back up your trips, turn Trip backup on again in Account
• Plus fixes to the sign's Bluetooth link and setup, drives with stops, the Live Activity, accessibility and privacy

Fixes sign setup, which stopped at the arrow test in the last build.

• Setting up your sign for the first time now works. After you pick your sign, the arrow test runs on it instead of saying it couldn't reach the sign. If setup failed for you in the last build, open the Sign tab and tap "Set up your sign" again
• Setting up a different sign no longer points NavSafe back at your old one partway through the test

You choose your sign, and drives get lane guidance and a stops list.

• Sign setup now lists the signs nearby and connects only to the one you pick. If the Sign tab says "No sign set up yet", tap "Set up your sign" once. NavSafe no longer connects to a sign you haven't chosen
• Setup checks which way the arrows point. If your sign is fitted upside down, "Turn the picture round" fixes it
• Name or forget your sign on the Sign tab, and see every picture it can show in "What your sign shows"
• The sign dims itself after sunset and stays amber at low brightness. It reconnects on its own during a drive, and it goes dark when GPS is weak instead of showing a turn that may be late
• Driving: lane guidance, the road after the next turn, a step list that updates when you're rerouted, and a stops list where you can skip or remove a stop
• The arrival time now counts to your final destination, not the next stop. A notice tells you when a faster route turns up
• When a drive ends, you get a summary: time, distance and how many turns your sign showed
• Explore shows your saved places on the map, plus travel times to Home and Work
• Place cards show fuel prices, EV charging and parking where Google has them
• Remove one recent search or clear them all. Your own places come first as you type
• Paste a Google Maps link into Search to open it. Long-press the NavSafe icon, or ask Siri, to drive home, drive to work or check your sign
• The drive, the route preview and Explore turn sideways in a landscape car mount
• You can also delete a single trip and view place photos full screen. Open-source licences are in About & legal

Clearer permissions, working policy links and a way out of password reset.

• The Privacy policy and Terms of use links in About, legal & data now open real pages
• Permission requests are clearer: location and Bluetooth explain exactly what they're used for, and the map no longer asks for Bluetooth unless you set up a sign
• If a password reset code can't be sent, you can now email support straight from the reset screen
• Help now shows iPhone settings steps only
• Small wording fixes in Trips

A cleaner, more consistent NavSafe, now in miles.

• Distances now show in miles and yards by default. You can switch to kilometres in Settings
• Driving: Google's extra buttons are gone. Pan the map and a Re-centre button brings you back. Traffic warnings still show
• Opening Settings during a drive no longer ends the drive, and nothing closes it without asking "End this drive?"
• A light map now stays light at night during a drive, matching the rest of the app
• The phone's sign preview shows a standby dash instead of a black box between turns
• The You tab is simpler: one place to sign in, and the old Account & settings page has been removed
• Trip details now give a plain summary: when, how long, how it ended, and what the sign showed
• Lists: add places straight from search, and undo if you remove one by mistake
• Tidier Explore, place details and route preview, a step-by-step sign setup, and clearer wording throughout

Fixes directions starting from an old position.

• Explore and the route preview now keep following your location, so a route always starts where you are now, not where the map last found you
• Opening directions from the You tab, or straight after returning to the app, waits a moment to confirm your position before routing
• The route preview shows your live location dot

First AltStore release of the redesigned NavSafe.

• New Explore map with category search and full place cards: photos, ratings, opening hours, phone and website
• New You tab: saved lists, Home and Work, recent destinations, trips and saved routes
• In-drive search along your route, route overview and steps, and sound controls
• A live mirror of the rear sign during navigation
• Light and dark themes that follow your iPhone

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: NavSafe uses Bluetooth to connect to your rear-window LED sign and show drivers behind you the next turn and distance.
privacy.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: NavSafe uses Bluetooth to connect to your rear-window LED sign and show drivers behind you the next turn and distance.
privacy.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: NavSafe reads your upcoming events that have a location, so you can get directions to them in one tap. It never changes your calendar.
privacy.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: NavSafe reads your upcoming events that have a location, so you can get directions to them in one tap. It never changes your calendar.
privacy.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: While turn-by-turn guidance is running, NavSafe keeps using your location when your screen locks or you switch apps, so spoken directions continue. Your rear-window sign goes dark until you return to NavSafe.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: NavSafe uses your location to show where you are on the map, find places near you, give turn-by-turn directions and show the next turn on your rear-window sign.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: NavSafe listens only after you tap the microphone, so you can say where you want to go instead of typing it.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: NavSafe turns what you say into a search when you tap the microphone. Where your iPhone supports it, this happens on your phone.
